items.summaryZh: 2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，乔治·拉塞尔在经历2026赛季艰难开局后终于重回最佳状态。拉塞尔在墨尔本站和中国站冲刺赛中获胜，但随后遭遇时机不佳的安全车等周期问题，影响了策略和赛车表现。

detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格表示，乔治·拉塞尔在经历了艰难的F1开局后已经"重回最佳状态"
尼科·罗斯伯格认为，在2026年F1赛季艰难的上半程之后，乔治·拉塞尔已经恢复到了他的最佳状态
2016年F1冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，乔治·拉塞尔终于回到了他的最佳状态。
拉塞尔在2026赛季的开局相当坎坷。这位英国车手以夺冠热门的身份来到揭幕战澳大利亚大奖赛，但在墨尔本站和中国站冲刺赛获胜之后，他遭遇了诸多问题，包括打乱他策略的不合时宜的安全车以及赛车故障。
与此同时，他十几岁的队友安东内利在日本大奖赛登上车手积分榜榜首，并在赛季上半段总共赢得了六场大奖赛。
但这位28岁的车手在夏休期后焕然一新地回归。他从杆位出发赢得了荷兰冲刺赛，并在荷兰大奖赛排位赛中获得第二。
在接受天空体育 F1采访时，Rosberg表示，围场里的人对Russell在赛季早些阶段缺乏纯粹速度这件事感到措手不及。
"他在赛季上半段的表现让我们所有人都非常惊讶，"Rosberg解释道，"你提到了运气不好，但不仅仅是运气不好，他的速度也不够快。Antonelli就是更快的那位车手。
"所以这周末看到他恢复到最佳状态真是太棒了，他看起来状态非常在线。也许他的订婚让他大脑里的某个开关被打开了。现在事情尘埃落定，他终于放松下来了，又变回了从前那个拉塞尔。
"这就是我们所知道的、他有能力达到的水平。"
Russell向天空体育 F1解释说，他现在对赛车的感觉更加直觉化了。"我希望这种状态（我的好状态）能继续保持。这个周末感觉更像一个正常的周末。赛车的手感更直觉化了，我对赛车更有信心，一切也就来得更自然了。
"看看今天会带来什么吧。这将会是一场有趣的比赛。我认为法拉利会很快，Lando也会很快，所以这将是一场精彩的较量。"
detailEn: Nico Rosberg says George Russell is "back at his best" after difficult F1 start
Nico Rosberg believes George Russell has returned to his best form after a difficult first half of the 2026 Formula 1 season
2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg believes George Russell is finally back to his best form.

Russell has endured a tricky start to the 2026 season. The Briton arrived at the season-opening Australian Grand Prix as a title favourite, but after winning in Melbourne and the Chinese sprint race, he faced multiple issues, including ill-timed safety cars that hampered his strategy and car problems.
Meanwhile, his teenage team-mate Kimi Antonelli took the lead of the standings at the Japanese Grand Prix and went on to win a total of six grands prix in the opening half of the season.
But the 28-year-old has returned after the summer break refreshed. He won the Dutch sprint race from pole position and qualified second for the Dutch Grand Prix.
Speaking to Sky Sports F1, Rosberg said the paddock had been caught off guard by Russell's lack of raw speed in some of the earlier stages of the season.

"It was a big surprise to all of us his performance in the first half of the season," Rosberg explained. "You mentioned bad luck but it wasn't just bad luck, he's also not been quick enough. Antonelli was just the quicker driver.

"So it's great to see him back at his best here this weekend, he seems really on it. Maybe his engagement has flipped a switch in his mind. He's finally relaxed now because that's done, and it's like the George Russell of old.
"This is the level we know he's capable of."

Russell explained to Sky Sports F1 that he was feeling more intuitive with the car. "I hope it [my form] continues. It feels more like a normal weekend. The car’s feeling more intuitive, I’ve got more confidence in the car, and then it just comes more naturally.
"Let’s see what today brings. It’s going to be an interesting race. I think the Ferraris are going to be quick, Lando will be fast, so it’s going to be a good fight."

items.originalTitle: 荷兰大奖赛首圈因维斯塔潘严重撞车被红旗中断
items.summaryEn: The Dutch Grand Prix was red-flagged on the opening lap after Max Verstappen spun into the barrier at the damp final corner. The race restarted at 3:33pm local time.
detailZh: 荷兰大奖赛在仅仅一圈后因马克斯·维斯塔潘的严重撞车而被出示红旗。
这位红牛车手在首圈结束时于倾斜的最后一弯打滑撞上护墙。
比赛在湿滑的赛道上开始，尽管维斯塔潘和其他所有车手都选择了干胎。最后一弯仍然特别湿滑。
当车阵抵达最后一弯时，维斯塔潘处于第七位。他似乎碰到了弯道内侧湿滑的路肩，这导致他的赛车打滑。当维斯塔潘试图纠正打滑时，他的赛车向左猛烈甩尾，并重重撞上外侧的护墙。
红牛赛车随后停下，维斯塔潘在爬出赛车前向车队致歉。
赛后发言时，维斯塔潘表示撞击没有可能发生的那么严重。“我想我仍然撞上了SAFER护栏，也许，有可能，”他说。“但我认为正面撞击实际上比侧面撞击要好一些，所以从这个意义上说，一切都还好。”
他并不是唯一在湿滑的最后一弯失去对赛车控制的的车手。两辆奥迪车手在加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托于尼科·霍肯伯格面前打滑后几乎相撞。虽然博尔托莱托令人印象深刻地在没有撞墙的情况下重新控制了赛车，但霍肯伯格在避让队友时上演了小小的奇迹。两人都继续比赛。
比赛于当地时间下午3:33重启。
detailEn: The Dutch Grand Prix has been red-flagged after a single lap due to a heavy crash for Max Verstappen.
The Red Bull driver spun into the barrier at the banked final corner at the end of the first lap.
The race began on a damp track, though Verstappen and all the other drivers opted for slick tyres. The final corner remained particularly wet.

Verstappen was in seventh place as the field reached the final corner. He appeared to touch the damp kerb on the inside of the corner, which tipped his car into a spin. As Verstappen attempted to correct the spin his car snapped hard to the left and made heavy contact with the barrier on the outside.
The Red Bull came to a rest shortly afterwards and Verstappen apologised to his team before climbing out.

Speaking after the race, Verstappen said the impact was not as serious as it could have been. “I think I still hit the SAFER barrier, maybe, potentially,” he said. “But I think also more frontal impact is actually a bit better than a sideways one, so from that sense, all okay.”

He wasn’t the only driver to lose control of his car in the damp final corner. The two Audi drivers almost collided after Gabriel Bortoleto spun in front of Nico Hulkenberg. While Bortoleto impressively regained control of his car without hitting the barrier, Hulkenberg performed a minor miracle in swerving to avoid his team mate. Both continued.
The race restarted at 3:33pm local time.
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘在最后一弯疑似压到内侧湿滑路肩导致打滑，赛车向左猛烈甩尾后重重撞上外侧护墙。
事故发生时维斯塔潘处于第七位，他爬出赛车前向车队致歉，赛后表示撞击没有可能发生的那么严重。
同样在湿滑的最后一弯，奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托打滑，尼科·霍肯伯格紧急避让避免相撞，两人均得以继续比赛。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen appeared to touch the damp kerb on the inside of the final corner, which tipped his car into a spin before it snapped left and made heavy contact with the outside barrier.
Verstappen was in seventh place when the crash occurred; he apologised to his team before climbing out and said afterwards the impact was not as serious as it could have been.
At the same damp final corner, Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto spun and Nico Hulkenberg swerved to avoid his team mate; both continued.

detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛因维斯塔潘撞车被红旗中断
马克斯·维斯塔潘最后一场F1主场比赛在首圈后结束，红牛赛车遭遇了巨大事故
F1荷兰大奖赛在首圈后因主场英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘的巨大事故而被红旗中断。
在潮湿赛道的首圈末段，维斯塔潘在赞德福特赛道最后一弯——通往主直道的倾斜全油门卢因迪克弯——内侧压到白线，导致红牛赛车失控。
维斯塔潘径直撞上外侧护墙，随后赛车横穿赛道，停在赛道内侧。
这位荷兰车手很快报告自己无恙，并为提前结束比赛向车队致歉。
维斯塔潘幸运地没有被其他赛车波及，阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利采取了避让动作，与此同时奥迪的尼科·霍肯伯格也险些遭遇巨大事故，因为他的队友加布里埃尔·博托莱托在他前方打转。
红旗期间所有车手聚集在维修区等待重启。他们必须在进入维修区前穿过一片碎片区，但车队被允许在红旗期间为重启更换轮胎。预计重启时间为当地时间15:33。
事发时维斯塔潘在令人失望的排位赛后排名第七。杆位得主兰多·诺里斯在混乱的起步阶段保持领先，积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利超越乔治·拉塞尔升至第二。
法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔上升两个位置，占据第四，领先于第二辆迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿。
对维斯塔潘而言，这起事故为他六年的主场作战画上了不幸的句号，他曾在2021、2022和2023年赢得荷兰大奖赛恢复举办后的前三届冠军。在组织者决定不再与F1管理层续约后，该赛事将从赛历中消失。
本周早些时候，这位四届世界冠军宣布他已将与红牛的合同延长至2030赛季末。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP red-flagged after Verstappen crash
Max Verstappen's final Formula 1 home race ended after one lap as the Red Bull suffered a colossal accident
Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix has been red-flagged after one lap following an enormous accident for home hero Max Verstappen.

At the end of lap 1 on a damp circuit, Verstappen lost control of his Red Bull as he tagged the white line on the inside of Zandvoort's final turn - the banked, flat out Luyendyk corner leading onto the main straight.
Verstappen veered head on into the outside wall, before his car crossed the track and came to a standstill on the inside.
The Dutchman soon reported he was OK and apologised to his team for ending his race early.

Verstappen was fortunate not to be collected by any other cars, with Alpine's Pierre Gasly taking avoiding action, while in the background Audi's Nico Hulkenberg also narrowly avoided a huge accident as his team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto spun in front of him.

Under the red flag all drivers gathered in the pitlane awaiting the restart. They were having to navigate a field of debris before pit entry, but teams are allowed to change tyres under a red flag ahead of the restart. That restart is expected at 15:33 local time.

At the time Verstappen was running seventh after a disappointing qualifying session. Polesitter Lando Norris retained his lead during a chaotic start sequence, with championship leader Kimi Antonelli passing George Russell for second.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc gaining two positions to hold down fourth ahead of the second McLaren of Oscar Piastri and team-mate Lewis Hamilton.

For Verstappen, the accident marks an unfortunate end to a six-year spell racing on home soil, winning the first three editions of the Dutch Grand prix revival in 2021, 2022 and 2023. The race will disappear from the calendar after organisers decided not to pursue a contract renewal with F1 management.
Earlier in the week, the four-time world champion announced he had extended his Red Bull contract until the end of the 2030 season.

阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利采取了避让动作，奥迪车手尼科·霍肯伯格也险些卷入事故，其队友加布里埃尔·博托莱托在他前方打转。
红旗期间所有车手聚集在维修区等待重启，预计当地时间15:33重启；维斯塔潘事发时排名第七，这是他六年来最后一次在主场作战，此前他曾在2021、2022和2023年赢得荷兰大奖赛前三届冠军。
keyPointsEn: The accident occurred at the end of lap 1 on a damp circuit; Verstappen lost control after touching the white line at the Luyendyk corner, hit the outside wall head-on, then crossed the track and came to a standstill on the inside.
Alpine's Pierre Gasly took avoiding action, while Audi's Nico Hulkenberg also narrowly avoided a huge accident as his team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto spun in front of him.

Under the red flag all drivers gathered in the pitlane awaiting the restart, expected at 15:33 local time; Verstappen was running seventh at the time, and this marks an unfortunate end to his six-year spell racing on home soil, having won the first three editions of the Dutch Grand Prix revival in 2021, 2022 and 2023.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛因维斯塔潘严重撞车被红旗中断
items.summaryZh: 在赞德沃特举行的F1荷兰大奖赛于第二圈开始时被红旗中断，主场车手马克斯·维斯塔潘在最后一个弯失控撞上护墙。
items.originalTitle: F1荷兰大奖赛因维斯塔潘严重撞车被红旗中断
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort was red-flagged at the start of lap two after home hero Max Verstappen lost control and crashed heavily. He immediately reported to his team that he was unhurt.
detailZh: 在赞德沃特举行的一级方程式荷兰大奖赛中，第二圈开始时，本土英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘发生严重撞车，比赛随即被出示红旗。
这是暂时而言的最后一届荷兰大奖赛，因为赞德沃特将交出其赛历中的位置；维斯塔潘在驾驶小红牛22通过最后一个弯道时失去控制撞上护栏，由于大量碎片以及赛车所处的危险位置，比赛被迫立即暂停。
维斯塔潘立即向车队报告，他在事故中没有受伤。
赛前降雨使赛道潮湿，但已经干燥到足以让全部22位车手在起步时选择光头胎。
但赛车在通过最后两个弯道时激起了大量水雾，维斯塔潘（Verstappen）在第七位发生严重撞车——此前在那一圈早些时候，他与临时队友利亚姆·劳森（劳森）有过一些轮对轮的接触。
加布里埃尔·博托莱托（博托莱托）也在同一个弯道发生了严重打滑，但他避开了护栏，因此得以继续驾驶他的奥迪（奥迪）赛车。
当时兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯）正处于领跑位置，排在基米·安东内利（安东内利）之前。
detailEn: Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort was red-flagged at the start of the second lap following a big shunt for local hero Max Verstappen.

In what is the final Dutch GP for the time being, as Zandvoort relinquishes its place on the grid, Verstappen lost control of his RB22 navigating the final corner and went into the barriers, necessitating an immediate suspension of the race due to the amount of debris and the precarious position of the car.
Verstappen reported to his team immediately that he was not hurt in the incident.
Pre-race rain had left the track dampened but it had dried enough for all 22 drivers to favour slicks for the start.

But cars were kicking up a substantial amount of spray coming through the final two corners and Verstappen crashed hard out of seventh place - having had a bit of wheel-to-wheel contact with his stand-in team-mate Liam Lawson earlier in the lap.
There was also a huge spin coming through the same corner for Gabriel Bortoleto, but he avoided the barriers and thus was able to continue in his Audi.
Lando Norris was the race leader ahead of Kimi Antonelli at the time.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格警告安东内利：F1冠军争夺战中的“心魔”
items.summaryZh: 2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格警告称，目前领跑积分榜的梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利在争夺首个世界冠军的过程中将面临越来越大的心理战。

items.originalTitle: 罗斯伯格警告安东内利：F1冠军争夺战中的“心魔”
items.summaryEn: 2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg has warned that Mercedes driver and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli will face a growing psychological battle as he fights for his maiden title.
detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格警告基米·安东内利注意F1冠军争夺中的“心魔”
尼科·罗斯伯格警告称，领跑积分榜的基米·安东内利可能面临越来越大的心理挑战
2016年一级方程式冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，梅赛德斯车手、现任积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利在争夺个人首个冠军的过程中将面临一场心理较量。
在荷兰大奖赛之前接受天空体育F1采访时，罗斯伯格结合自己夺冠的经历，解释了安东内利在赛季后期可能遭遇的心理压力。
Antonelli在他参加这项赛事的第二年表现出色，成为领跑积分榜最年轻的车手。但Rosberg警告说，随着争夺冠军的现实逐渐成为现实，压力将不可避免地增大。
"Antonelli的表现真是太出色了，"Rosberg解释道。"这是世界级的水平。太惊人了。这只是他在F1的第二年，难以置信。"
尽管给予了称赞，这位前梅赛德斯车手强调，对潜在夺冠机会的认知会带来干扰性的想法，这些想法可能会让车手的整个赛季偏离轨道。
"不过，他也只是个普通人，"他补充道。"任何处于他这种境地的人，随着赛季的推进，都会开始想'天哪，我的梦想触手可及'，脑海中的心魔会告诉你'你最好别搞砸了，这冠军是你不能输的'，这种想法不断重复且越来越响亮，你会开始在这种压力下挣扎，心想'天哪，希望我别搞砸了'。"
罗斯伯格在经过一场贯穿整个赛季的艰苦争夺、击败梅赛德斯队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿夺得2016年总冠军几天后，就从F1退役了。这位德国车手承认，冠军争夺战的压力使他在精神上已无法从赛车中榨取最佳性能。
“一旦你想到了那些事情，就会削弱你以100%状态驾驶的能力，”罗斯伯格继续说道，“我当时深陷其中，这就是为什么在我那个年代的最后四场比赛中，我根本没有机会拿到杆位或赢下比赛。我做不到。我的大脑已经烧坏了。”
安东内利目前以224分领跑车手积分榜。汉密尔顿以171分排名第二，乔治·拉塞尔以168分位居第三。
detailEn: Nico Rosberg warns Kimi Antonelli of F1 title "demons"
Nico Rosberg has warned that championship leader Kimi Antonelli could face a growing psychological battle
2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg believes Mercedes driver and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli will face a psychological battle as he fights for his maiden title.

Speaking to Sky Sports F1 ahead of the Dutch Grand Prix, Rosberg drew on his own championship-winning experience to explain the mental toll Antonelli could encounter during the latter stages of the season.

Antonelli has impressed during his second year in the series, becoming the youngest driver to lead the championship. But Rosberg warned that the pressure will inevitably mount as the reality of a title shot sets in.
"Antonelli has driven so incredibly well," Rosberg explained. "It’s a world-class level. It’s amazing. It’s his second year in F1, unbelievable."
Despite the praise, the former Mercedes driver stressed that the realisation of a potential championship victory introduces intrusive thoughts that can derail a driver's campaign.

"However, he’s only human," he added. "Anybody in his situation, as the season goes on, you start to reflect ‘my goodness, my dream is within reach’ and the demons in your head tell you ‘you better not mess this up, it’s yours to lose’ and that repeats and gets louder and louder and you start to struggle under that and think ‘oh my God I hope I don’t mess this up’."

Rosberg retired from F1 just a few days after beating Mercedes team-mate Lewis Hamilton to the 2016 title following a gruelling, season-long battle. The German admitted that the pressure of the title fight meant he was mentally incapable of extracting maximum performance from the car.

"Once you think about those things, it takes capacity away from your ability to drive at 100%," Rosberg continued. "I went through that big time and that’s why the last four races in my day, there was no chance for me to do a pole position or win a race. I could not. My brain was fried."
Antonelli currently leads the drivers' championship with 224 points. Hamilton sits second with 171 points, and George Russell is third with 168 points.

items.originalTitle: 多梅尼卡利：无法想象F1没有维斯塔潘
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 chief Stefano Domenicali has reacted buoyantly to Max Verstappen's contract extension with Red Bull, saying he cannot see F1 without him. The four-time world champion announced on Thursday a new deal taking his contract from the end of 2028 to the end of 2030.
detailZh: 斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利 "无法想象" 没有马克斯·维斯塔潘的F1
这位红牛车手周四宣布延长合同，意味着合同现在将到2030年到期
F1掌门人斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利对马克斯·维斯塔潘延长红牛合同做出了欣然的回应
这位四届世界冠军周四宣布，他与这支奥地利车队签署了一份新合同，将合同到期日期从2028年底延长至2030年底。
因此，这也终结了关于这位28岁车手可能在接下来的几个赛季离开F1的猜测——由于维斯塔潘对新规则的不满，这一传闻在2026年初甚嚣尘上。
但这项锦标赛已承诺在2027年进行调整，例如提高对内燃机（ICE）动力的依赖，这促使维斯塔潘将自己的效力延续至现行规则周期的结束。
多梅尼卡利在本周末的荷兰大奖赛上表示：“马克斯将在未来几年继续留在红牛的消息，是本周末蛋糕上的一颗樱桃。”
“这是一个很棒的消息。我感到非常自豪和高兴，因为马克斯是世界冠军，是一位世界级的杰出人物，在这项运动中拥有极佳的个人魅力，我无法想象没有他的F1。”
但这位荷兰车手未能在本周末以漂亮的方式庆祝他的新合同，因为红牛在赞德沃特陷入了困境——维斯塔潘曾于2021年至2023年在这里连续三年夺冠。
这位感觉“有点像感冒”的世界冠军在冲刺赛中仅获得第六名——也就是他的发车位，并在周日大奖赛的排位赛中名列第七，比杆位得主兰多·诺里斯慢了0.5秒。
他认为这条海滨赛道比大多数赛道更容易暴露小红牛22的弱点，而且这甚至与调校无关，因为他将与队友利亚姆·劳森共享第四排发车位。
“冲刺赛之后我们对赛车做了相当多的改动，但没有任何一项产生效果，”维斯塔潘说道。
“赛车的平衡是最大的问题。它在整个弯道中就是不够一致，而且整个赛季都是这样。只是在某些赛道上情况比其他赛道更糟一些。
“我们现在主要受到赛车一些根本性问题的限制，这些问题我们需要解决。
“在这条赛道上也有一些快速弯道，我们在这方面同样有所欠缺。总的来说，如果没有良好的平衡，你就无法真正全力攻弯；如果没有足够的抓地力，你也无法正常出弯，所以这一切都在损失时间。”
detailEn: Stefano Domenicali "cannot see" F1 without Max Verstappen
The Red Bull driver announced his contract extension on Thursday, meaning it will now expire in 2030
Formula 1 chief Stefano Domenicali has responded buoyantly to Max Verstappen extending his Red Bull contract.
The four-time world champion announced on Thursday that he’d signed a new deal with the Austrian outfit, taking the expiry date from the end of 2028 to the end of 2030.
It has therefore ended speculation that the 28-year-old may depart F1 in the coming seasons, which is talk that ran strife early in 2026 due to Verstappen’s discontent with the new regulations.
But the championship has committed to tweaks for 2027 such as increasing the reliance on ICE power, which led Verstappen to extend his stay through to the end of the current regulation cycle.
Domenicali said at this weekend’s Dutch Grand Prix: “The news of Max staying in Red Bull for the next couple of years is a cherry on the cake for this weekend.
“It’s great news. I’m very proud and happy because Max is a world champion, a world-class person that has a great personality in the sport and I cannot see Formula 1 without him.”
But the Dutchman has been unable to celebrate his new contract in style this weekend, as Red Bull has struggled at Zandvoort - where Verstappen won three on the bounce from 2021 to 2023.

The world champion, who is feeling a “bit flu-like”, only finished sixth - the position he started - in the sprint race and qualified seventh for Sunday’s grand prix, five tenths off polesitter Lando Norris.
He reckons the seaside circuit is a venue that exposes the RB22’s weaknesses more than most and it isn’t even related to set-up, as he will share the fourth row with team-mate Liam Lawson.
“We changed quite a lot on the car after the sprint, but none of it made any difference,” said Verstappen.
“The balance of the car is the biggest problem. It’s just not consistent throughout the entire corner, but it has been like that all season. It’s just a little worse at some circuits than at others.
“We’re now simply more limited by some fundamental problems with the car that we need to solve.

“At this circuit you also have some fast corners and we’re lacking there as well. In general, if you don’t have a good balance, you can’t really attack the corners and if you don’t have traction either, you can’t get out of the corners properly, so all of that costs time.”
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘的新合同使原定2028年底到期的合同延长至2030年底
keyPointsEn: Verstappen's new contract extends his previous deal, which was due to expire at the end of 2028, to the end of 2030.

items.originalTitle: 兰多·诺里斯：希望梅赛德斯在拉斯维加斯被双取消资格，并在卡塔尔忘记进站
items.summaryEn: Defending champion Lando Norris, currently only fifth in the drivers' standings, has joked that his hopes of retaining the title depend on the Mercedes drivers hitting trouble in the second half of the season. He echoed legendary commentator Murray Walker's saying that "F1 is 'if' spelled backwards", noting that Formula 1 is prone to unexpected outcomes.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯：我希望梅赛德斯在拉斯维加斯被双双取消资格，然后在卡塔尔忘记进站
这位卫冕世界冠军开玩笑说，他卫冕冠军的机会取决于梅赛德斯车手在赛季下半程遭遇“香蕉皮”（倒霉事）
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
正如传奇的英国一级方程式电视解说员默里·沃克曾说过的：“F1 是‘如果’的倒写”。虽然这一修辞手法的语法细节或许经不起仔细推敲，但事实仍然是，一级方程式运动常常会出现意想不到的结果。
这就是卫冕冠军诺里斯所指望的，因为在赛季第11轮比赛之前，他在车手积分榜上以112分远远落后于冠军领跑者安东内利的224分，仅列第五。上赛季11轮过后，他排名第二，落后于他的迈凯伦队友皮亚斯特里——后者当时已赢下五场大奖赛并另外四次登上领奖台，而四届世界冠军维斯塔潘则看起来已无缘争冠。
但在赞德沃特之后，Piastri仅再赢过一场大奖赛，Norris随即反超登上榜首，然而在赛季末的几轮中，两人都几乎被Verstappen追上——在拉斯维加斯和卡塔尔的灾难性比赛使得冠军之争直到最后一刻才见分晓。
正因如此，这位英国车手并没有把自己排除在本赛季争冠之外，尽管他明白梅赛德斯的统治格局需要类似2025年那样的剧情反转才能被打破。这也解释了他在荷兰大奖赛排位赛夺得杆位后，被问及夺冠前景时那番略显轻描淡写的回答。
“显然，去年我们就是那种局面的受害者，”他说，“但现在去想这些没有意义。”
“说实话，我根本不在乎下周末或下下周末我要做什么。知道这是一种可能性很不错，当然，我希望梅赛德斯在拉斯维加斯像我们一样被双重取消资格，然后在卡塔尔决定不进站，好让我们免费进站一次。所以只要他们犯同样的错误，事情大概就会一样轻松。
“不过是的，每一年都不一样。对我来说，我们仍然在某些方面努力追赶，但目前我已经把车子的每一分性能都发挥出来了，这就是我唯一能感到欣慰的。所以，我很开心。前面还有很长的路要走。
“我是乐观的，我仍然相信这是有可能的，这就是我现在所需要的。”
诺里斯，迈凯伦；拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
在诺里斯（Norris）赢得去年圣保罗大奖赛——24站比赛中的第21站——之后，香槟实际上已经冰镇待庆，因为他以390分领先皮亚斯特里（Piastri）的366分，维斯塔潘（Verstappen）则以341分位居第三。但随后迈凯伦在接下来两站比赛中表现得非常吃力。诺里斯和皮亚斯特里在拉斯维加斯分别以第二名和第四名完赛，却因赛车底板过度磨损而被取消资格。
在下一个周末的卡塔尔站，F1轮胎供应商倍耐力（Pirelli）规定大奖赛中每套轮胎最多使用25圈，以防范该赛道锋利路缘石造成损伤的影响。鉴于比赛全长57圈，这意味着至少需要两次进站。
比赛中，皮亚斯特里和诺里斯分别处于第一和第三位，当第7圈安全车出动时，一个显而易见的首次进站机会出现了。所谓显而易见，是对场上大多数车手而言，唯独迈凯伦例外——它让自己的车手留在了赛道上。
不得不在绿旗条件下两次进站使两辆迈凯伦损失了赛道位置，最终分别以第二和第四名完赛，维斯塔潘赢得比赛。这使得阿布扎比的收官战变得悬念重重，而诺里斯本应在离开卡塔尔之前就将总冠军收入囊中。
detailEn: Lando Norris: I hope Mercedes gets a double disqualification in Las Vegas and forgets to pit in Qatar
The defending world champion joked that the chances of retaining his title rely on the Mercedes drivers encountering banana skins in the second half of the season
Lando Norris, McLaren, George Russell, Mercedes

As the legendary British Formula 1 TV commentator Murray Walker once said “F1 is ‘if’ backwards”. While the grammatical details of this rhetorical flourish perhaps don’t stand up to close examination, the fact remains that Formula 1 is prone to unexpected outcomes.

This is what defending champion Lando Norris is relying upon since he now lies a distant fifth in the drivers’ standings ahead of the 11th round of the season, with 112 points to championship leader Kimi Antonelli’s 224. After 11 rounds last season, he was lying second to his McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri, who had won five grands prix and claimed four other podium finishes, while four-time world champion Max Verstappen looked to be out of the picture.

But Piastri then won just one other grand prix after Zandvoort as Norris moved into the lead, only for them both to be almost overtaken by Verstappen in the final rounds, where disastrous races in Las Vegas and Qatar meant the championship battle went down to the wire.

For that reason, the Briton isn’t counting himself out this season, though he knows the pattern of Mercedes dominance needs to be bent out of shape by a similar turn of events to those in 2025. Hence his somewhat flippant answer to a question about his championship chances after qualifying on pole position for the Dutch GP.
“Obviously, we were on the not-so-good end of it last year,” he said. “But there’s no point thinking about it.

“I honestly don’t care what I’m doing next weekend or the weekend after. It’s nice to know that it’s a possibility, and of course I’m hoping Mercedes get a double DSQ in Vegas like we did and decide not to box in Qatar for a free pitstop. So as long as they make the same mistakes, it’ll probably be just as easy.

“But yeah, every year is different. For me, we’re still trying to play catch-up with certain things, but I’m getting everything out of it for now, and that’s all I can be pleased about. So, I’m happy. It’s still a very long way to go.
“I’m optimistic, I still believe that it’s possible, and that’s all I need for now.”
Lando Norris, McLaren, George Russell, Mercedes

After Norris won last year’s Sao Paulo Grand Prix, round 21 of 24, the champagne was practically on ice since he led by 390 points to Piastri’s 366, with Verstappen on 341. But McLaren then made very heavy weather of the following two rounds. Norris and Piastri finished second and fourth on the road in Las Vegas but were then disqualified for excessive plank wear on the underfloor of their cars.

At the next weekend, in Qatar, F1 tyre supplier Pirelli mandated a maximum limit of 25 laps for each set of tyres in the grand prix, to protect against the effect of damage from that circuit’s sharp kerb edges. Given the 57-lap duration of the race, this meant a minimum of two stops.

During the race, Piastri and Norris were running first and third when a safety car deployment on lap seven created a very obvious opportunity to make the first of these stops. Obvious, that is, to the majority of the field except McLaren, which left its drivers out.

Having to make two stops under green-flag conditions cost the McLarens track position and they finished second and fourth as Verstappen won, setting up a dramatic finale in Abu Dhabi when Norris should have put the championship beyond reach before leaving Qatar.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦认为法拉利在赞德福特最快，但可能陷入困境
items.summaryZh: 法拉利在赞德福特冲刺赛中的出色表现令一级方程式对手提高警惕，但令人失望的排位赛成绩可能使其在正赛中无法发挥优势。

items.originalTitle: 迈凯伦认为法拉利在赞德福特最快，但可能陷入困境
items.summaryEn: Ferrari's impressive sprint race at Zandvoort has put its Formula 1 rivals on high alert, but a disappointing qualifying performance may leave the team unable to use its advantage in the grand prix.
detailZh: 为什么迈凯伦认为法拉利在赞德沃特速度最快，但却很可能被困住
勒克莱尔在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中令人印象深刻的软胎节奏，让对手们陷入了深思
法拉利在赞德沃特令人印象深刻的冲刺赛表现让其一级方程式对手们高度警惕，但令人失望的排位赛成绩可能会让车队无法在大奖赛中发挥自己的优势。
法拉利在周六的冲刺赛中看起来很强势，尤其是勒克莱尔，他对自己赛车调校的方向比队友汉密尔顿满意得多。
作为唯一一位没有使用更耐久的中性胎、而是用软胎完成比赛的前列车手，勒克莱尔耐心等待时机，最终找到机会超越诺里斯，拿下第二名，仅次于冠军拉塞尔。
迈凯伦负责人安德烈亚·斯特拉表示，车队认为勒克莱尔的轮胎选择“相当激进”，但法拉利显然有充分的理由相信这一选择会带来回报。事实也确实如此——当诺里斯苦于后胎性能衰退时，勒克莱尔完成超越。
法拉利这次耐人寻味的软胎策略，无疑值得对手在正赛全程开始前好好琢磨；但根据斯特拉的说法，这也可能与SF-26在正赛节奏下的速度比排位赛更强的表现有关。
斯特拉指出：“我认为，法拉利在第一次自由练习中连续做出的单圈速度是最好的。而且在正赛中，勒克莱尔的节奏很可能也依然是最快的。不过，我不确定这是与软胎有关，还是仅仅因为他们在比赛节奏方面就是最快的车。”
"所以，我认为所有车队都会看看勒克莱尔的正赛长距离表现，然后会去思考：'这是因为他们的车，还是因为我们需要在策略上考虑一些东西？'"
安德烈亚·斯特拉表示，法拉利在正赛节奏方面是"最快的"
法拉利通常会更高兴自己的正赛速度比单圈速度快，但考虑到在赞德沃特这条狭窄多弯的赛道上超车非常困难，这一点在本周末就不那么适用了。
"我们正在尽力让赛车尽可能快，但就我们赛车本身的特性而言，它在正赛中的表现比排位赛中要好一些，"勒克莱尔说道，他在排位赛中获得第六名，落后杆位0.395秒，落后队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿0.064秒。"我更愿意是这样，而不是反过来，但在这样的赛道上，这帮不了什么忙。
不过，尽管荷兰大奖赛预计将是一场相当简单的一停比赛，法拉利能否真正利用其正赛节奏优势，还是会干脆被困在车流之中，仍有待观察。它的主要选择似乎是用软胎起步——与直接竞争对手不同，两位车手都各自保存了一套全新的软胎——以便在发车时抢占地盘，然后提前进站，引诱对手在更受偏好的硬胎上进行漫长的第二节（阶段）行程，或者借此获得赛道位置。
车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔在排位赛后无疑暗示了这种情景。"我们为明天保存了一套全新的软胎，而且我们是前三排中唯一这样做的车队，"他在与天空体育（天空体育）的交谈中提到了法拉利的策略灵活性。"这是积极的，让我们看看我们能做些什么。今天上午的正赛节奏很好。这意味着我们可以放手一搏，争取明天做得更好。你们看到了，我们是能够完成超车的……"
detailEn: Why McLaren thinks Ferrari is quickest in Zandvoort, but may well be stuck
Charles Leclerc's impressive soft-tyre pace in the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race has given its rivals food for thought

Ferrari's impressive sprint race at Zandvoort has put its Formula 1 rivals on high alert, but a disappointing qualifying performance may leave the Scuderia unable to use its advantage in the grand prix.
Ferrari looked strong in Saturday's sprint, especially in the hands of Charles Leclerc who was much happier with his set-up direction than team-mate Lewis Hamilton.

As the only frontrunner to complete the race on soft tyres instead of more durable medium rubber, Leclerc bided his time until he found a way past Norris for second place behind winner George Russell.

McLaren chief Andrea Stella said his team found Leclerc's tyre choice "quite ambitious", but the team would have obviously had good reasons to believe it would pay off. And it did, as Leclerc picked off Norris when the latter was struggling with rear tyre degradation.

Ferrari's intriguing soft-tyre run is certainly food for thought for its rivals ahead of the full-distance grand prix, but according to Stella it could also have been a factor of how quick the SF-26 is in race trim compared to its less robust qualifying performance.

"I think the lap times of Ferrari in continuous laps that they showed during practice one, they were the best," Stella observed. "And probably in the race, Leclerc was still the best in terms of pace. Now, I'm not sure whether this is associated with the soft tyres or simply because they have the fastest car when it comes to race pace.
"So, I think all teams will take a look at Leclerc's run and will try to think: 'Was it because of their car or is it because we need to consider something for the strategy?'"
Andrea Stella says Ferrari is "the best in terms of pace" in the race

Ferrari would generally be pretty pleased to be faster in race trim than over a single lap, but given how difficult overtaking is on the tight and twisty Zandvoort loop, that doesn't apply as much to this weekend.

"We're trying to make the car as fast as possible, but for the characteristics we have it works a little bit better in the race than in qualifying," Leclerc said as he qualified sixth, 0.395s off pole and 0.064s behind team-mate Lewis Hamilton. "I prefer that way than the other way, but on a track like this, it doesn't help.

With the Dutch Grand Prix expected to be a fairly straightforward one-stop race, though, it remains to be seen if Ferrari can actually leverage that race pace advantage or if it will be simply stuck in traffic. Its main option appears a start on soft, of which both drivers have saved a brand-new set unlike their direct rivals, to make up ground at the start and then pit early to lure its rivals into a long second stint on the preferred hard tyres, or gain track position.

Team principal Fred Vasseur certainly alluded to that scenario after qualifying. "We save one set of new [soft] tyres for tomorrow and we are the only one on the first three rows," he mentioned Ferrari's strategic flexibility in conversation with Sky. "This is positive and let's see what we can do. The race pace was good this morning. It means that we can push and try to do better tomorrow. You see that we were able to overtake..."

items.summaryZh: 在F1荷兰大奖赛排位赛中，刘易斯·汉密尔顿对法拉利SF-26赛车在出场圈无法充分预热轮胎感到困惑，他和夏尔·勒克莱尔都需要两圈热身圈才能让轮胎进入合适的工作温度窗口。两人在Q3中分别仅列第五和第六，追平了他们今年夏天的最差成绩。

items.originalTitle: “这太疯狂了”——汉密尔顿对法拉利轮胎升温问题感到困惑
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton was baffled by the Ferrari SF-26's inability to sufficiently warm its tyres over an out-lap during Dutch Grand Prix qualifying, with both he and Charles Leclerc needing two warm-up laps at Zandvoort. The pair qualified only fifth and sixth in Q3, equalling their worst results this summer.
detailZh: “这简直太疯狂了”——刘易斯·汉密尔顿对法拉利的轮胎升温难题感到困惑
两位法拉利车手在排位赛冲刺前都需要两圈暖胎圈，这让汉密尔顿百思不得其解
在F1荷兰大奖赛上，刘易斯·汉密尔顿对法拉利SF-26无法在出站圈中充分预热轮胎感到困惑。
在赞德沃特，汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔都需要两圈暖胎圈才能让轮胎进入合适的工作温度区间。他们在Q3中挣扎，分别仅排名第五和第六，追平了他们今年夏天最差的表现，比杆位得主兰多·诺里斯慢了三四个十分之一秒。
“我认为轮胎是今天最大的罪魁祸首，就是很难让轮胎进入工作状态，”汉密尔顿在排位赛后评论道。“第一个赛段轮胎根本没进入状态，我们大部分时间都损失在那里，然后在一圈的过程中它们才逐渐变好。
“跑一个出场圈和一个准备圈，轮胎到1号弯还是没准备好，这简直太疯狂了。所以，你根本没有信心去全力攻1号弯。我认为这是今天最大的差距。”
当被问及他的赛车在出场圈之后是否还能做出一个飞驰圈时，这位英国车手说：“做不到出场圈之后直接就上。轮胎基本上是冷的。所以我不知道他们最后是怎么做到的。我们做不到。所以，幸好雨没有来，我们得以再跑了一圈。”
当后来有人指出其他车队做得更好时，这位七届世界冠军只能表示同意：“他们昨天确实做得更好，今天也一样。”
Leclerc在Q3结束后的评估也大致相同——他在首轮飞驰圈后一度排在第四位，但在方格旗挥动时已经下滑到第六位。
“我觉得（跑两个暖胎圈）是正确的选择，”这位摩纳哥车手说。“显然，从车里我对周围发生的情况看不太清楚，但感觉他们在第二轮做出的进步比我们更大。我需要研究一下。
“从我暖胎圈之后轮胎的状态来看，我不后悔做那个准备圈，尤其是因为第二圈时雨并没有下得更大，所以我们并不是遇到了不同的条件。他们设法让轮胎在第一圈就进入了工作温度，而我们没能做到。”
不过这对法拉利来说并非世界末日，Hamilton称他的队友在冲刺赛中的比赛节奏“相当不错”，并预计他在周日的表现会更好。
“我们的赛车在正赛中似乎比排位赛中更快，这确实是一个趋势，而排位赛大多数时候都有点吃力，”勒克莱尔思考道。“昨天有点例外，我们在排位赛中表现很强，但除此之外我们似乎总是有点处于劣势。”
“我们必须在这方面下功夫，这不是非黑即白的事情，也不像说‘好吧，我从正赛调校里取一点放进排位赛调校’或者反过来那么简单。我们正在努力让赛车尽可能快，但就我们现有的特性而言，它在正赛中的表现比排位赛稍好一些。我宁愿是这样也不愿反过来，但在这样一条（难以超车的）赛道上，这并没有什么帮助。”
detailEn: “It’s just nuts” – Lewis Hamilton baffled by Ferrari’s tyre-warming struggle
Both Ferrari drivers required two warm-up laps ahead of their qualifying attempts, which blows Hamilton’s mind
Lewis Hamilton was left baffled by the Ferrari SF-26 inability to sufficiently warm its tyres up over an out-lap at Formula 1’s Dutch Grand Prix.

Both Hamilton and Charles Leclerc required two warm-up laps for their tyres to be in the right temperature window at Zandvoort. They struggled to fifth and sixth respectively in Q3, equalling their worst performance this summer, three to four tenths adrift of polesetter Lando Norris.

“I think the tyres were the biggest culprit today, just really struggling to get the tyres to work,” Hamilton commented after qualifying. “They're not really in in the first sector, that's where we lost most of our time, and then they get better through the lap.

“Just do an out-lap and a prep lap, and the tyres are still not ready for Turn 1, it's just nuts. So, you just don't have the confidence to attack Turn 1. I think that was the biggest difference today.”

Asked if his car even could have done a flying lap after the out-lap, the Briton said: “Couldn't do an out-lap and straight in. The tyres were cold, basically. So, I don't know how they did that at the end. We couldn't. So, luckily the rain didn't come, and we got another lap in.”
When it was later suggested other teams were doing a better job, the seven-time world champion could only concur: “They definitely did yesterday, and they did today as well.”
Leclerc had a similar assessment of the situation following a Q3 session where he held fourth place after his first run before dropping down to sixth by the time the chequered flag was waved.

“I felt like [doing two warm-up laps] was the right choice,” the Monegasque said. “Obviously, from the car I don't have a very good view of what's happening around, but it feels like they did a bigger step on the second run than we did. I'll have to look into it.

“With how the tyres felt after my warm-up lap, I don't regret doing the prep lap, especially because the rain didn't fall more on the second lap, so it's not that we had different conditions. They managed to put the tyres in temperature for the first lap, we didn't manage to do that.”
But this isn’t the end of the world for Ferrari, with Hamilton branding his team-mate’s race pace as “particularly good” in the sprint and expecting even better on Sunday.

“It's definitely a tendency where we seem to be faster in the race than we are in qualifying, and qualifying most of the time is a bit more of a struggle,” Leclerc pondered. “Yesterday was a bit of an exception and we were strong in qualifying, but otherwise we always seem to be a bit on the back foot.

“We've got to work on that, it's not black and white and it's not as easy as saying, ‘OK, I'll take a little bit from the race and put it in qualifying’ or vice versa. We're trying to make the car as fast as possible, but for the characteristics we have it works a little bit better in the race than in qualifying. I prefer that way than the other way, but on a track like this [where overtaking is difficult], it doesn't help.”

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：安东内利称周末为“警钟”
items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛排位赛中仅列第三，错失杆位，此前冲刺赛排位冲出赛道损坏赛车并在冲刺赛中只获第四，他称这个周末是一次“警钟”。

media.altZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：安东内利称周末为“警钟”

items.originalTitle: F1荷兰大奖赛：安东内利称周末为“警钟”
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli qualified only third for the Dutch Grand Prix after going off track in sprint qualifying and finishing fourth in the sprint, calling the weekend a "wake-up call" for the championship leader.
detailZh: 为什么F1荷兰大奖赛周末对安东内利来说是一次"警钟"
这位积分榜领跑者在冲刺赛排位赛中的失误最终让他付出了错失领奖台的代价，而他还觉得另一个失误使他错过了正赛的杆位
安东内利在周日荷兰大奖赛正赛排位赛获得第三名后的表情说明了一切：又一次机会从指间溜走了。
对这个积分榜领跑者来说，这是一个不太理想的周末：他在冲刺赛排位赛中冲出赛道导致赛车受损，最终只能以第四名完成冲刺赛。随后他觉得自己本应拿下周日正赛（计分赛）的杆位，但在最后一个排位飞驰圈的开端没有足够用力地推进。
"我认为这个周末在夏休期之后给我们敲了一个很好的警钟，就是你绝不能放松警惕," 他在排位赛后说道。
"所以，这是一次很好的警钟，尤其是着眼于接下来的几场比赛。"
赞德沃特狭窄、起伏的赛道布局加上带横向坡度的弯道组合，使得超车非常困难，因此排位赛在这个场地尤为重要。在冲刺赛排位赛的第一节中，安东内利在倒数第二个弯Kumhobocht的入弯处推得太狠，冲出赛道碾过了砂石区。
这损坏了他赛车的底板，估计损失了25个单位的下压力。由于更换整个底板是一项非常耗时的工作，他在接下来的整个阶段中不得不一直承受这个后果。
因此，安东内利表现出色，在冲刺赛排位赛中拿到第五名，随后超越了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦，升至第四位。但尽管皮亚斯特里的队友兰多·诺里斯因后轮衰退而从第二掉到第三，他仍未能进一步提升名次。
随后，大奖赛的最终排位赛由降雨主导。当天早些时候的大雨清洗了赛道表面，这意味着随着更多橡胶层被铺设，排位赛过程中的圈速会越来越快。对更多降雨的预期也影响了各车队在最终排位赛中的策略。
通常情况下，赛道在排位赛的最后一刻速度最快。但由于预报显示结束前五分钟会下雨，大多数车队让车手提前出场进行最后一轮飞行圈。
由于赞德沃特的赛道布局使车辆左侧轮胎承受更多能量，大多数车手发现在飞行圈之前需要多跑一圈额外的轮胎准备圈，以使两侧轮胎都达到工作温度。即便如此，在冲刺圈开始时驶入第一个弯角时，轮胎状态仍可能不完全理想。
鉴于最后一个排位赛段开始下雨，只有法拉利坚持了这一做法，而其他车队则指示车手采取常规方式，即只跑一个准备圈后才开始做冲刺圈。
“说实话，我在整个节中都为赛车的平衡感到挣扎，”安东内利说。
“主要是第三计时段，我在减速弯里很挣扎。然后做了一些调整，感觉就回来了。”
“但显然，在最后一圈我在第一计时段犯了个错误。看到面罩上有雨，我跑得有点太保守了，结果第一计时段跑得很差。很遗憾，因为我觉得我们本来有机会争夺杆位。”
赞德福特（Zandvoort）的一号弯具有挑战性，因为入弯前赛道会向下倾斜，使得判断刹车时机变得更加困难，但弯道本身的路面倾斜角度对车手是有利的。周六排位赛期间，不确定的轮胎温度、越来越潮湿的赛道表面以及阵阵逆风，让判断刹车力度的过程变得更加复杂。
对比遥测数据表明，安东内利（Antonelli）比最终夺得杆位的迈凯伦车手诺里斯（Norris）更早松开油门并提前刹车。安东内利也很早就松开了刹车，这表明他在那时已经意识到自己判断失误了。
与安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）相比，诺里斯在一号弯也损失了一些时间，而拉塞尔最终获得排位第二。不过诺里斯在圈速的其他路段弥补了更多时间，反超了拉塞尔的优势，而安东内利在三号弯推进过猛，略微跑宽，削弱了他在圈速其他路段挽回时间的机会。
他比诺里斯慢了0.133秒，将从发车区第三位起步。
“在第一节自由练习赛中我感觉非常好，”安东内利谈到他的这个周末时说。“然后显然昨天在[冲刺赛]排位赛中我犯了一个错误，这肯定让我失去了一些信心。
另外，在今天今天的排位赛中，主要是因为与赛车的感觉不太到位，我仍然很难找到自己的节奏并跑出连贯的圈速。但幸运的是，在Q3中我们能够把一些东西更好地整合起来，最终排在了第二排。
安东内利目前以224分领跑车手总冠军，法拉利车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿以171分位居第二。他会铭记这样的事实：去年的这个时候，皮亚斯特里曾以309分领先诺里斯的275分位居积分榜榜首，马克斯·维斯塔潘以205分排名第三。皮亚斯特里此后再没有赢得任何一场大奖赛，最终只获得了年度第三名。
detailEn: Why the F1 Dutch GP weekend has been a "wake-up call" for Kimi Antonelli
The championship leader's mistake in sprint qualifying ultimately cost a podium finish, and he felt another error meant he missed out on pole position for the main race
Kimi Antonelli's face after qualifying third for Sunday's final Dutch Grand Prix said it all: another opportunity had slipped away.

It has been a less than optimal weekend for the championship leader after an off-track excursion in sprint qualifying damaged his car, ultimately consigning him to fourth in that race. He then felt he should have been on pole position for Sunday's main points-paying race, but didn't push hard enough at the beginning of his final qualifying lap.
"I think this weekend has been a great wake-up call after the summer break, that you can never let your guard down," he said after qualifying.
"So, it was a good wake-up call, especially looking ahead to the next ones [races]."

Zandvoort's narrow, undulating layout with a mix of cambered corners militates against overtaking so qualifying is especially important at this venue. In the first segment of sprint qualifying Antonelli pushed too hard at the entry to Kumhobocht, the penultimate corner, and ran wide over the gravel.

That damaged the underfloor of his car and cost an estimated 25 points of downforce. He then had to live with the consequences throughout the rest of the session because changing an entire floor is a time-consuming job.

Antonelli therefore did well to qualify fifth for the sprint, then passed Oscar Piastri's McLaren for fourth place. But he was unable to make further progress despite Piastri's team-mate Lando Norris suffering with rear-tyre degradation and dropping back from second to third late on.

Final qualifying for the grand prix was then defined by rain. Heavy showers earlier in the day had cleaned the track surface, dictating that laptimes would get much quicker over the course of qualifying as more rubber was laid down. The expectation of more rain then influenced the teams' approaches to final qualifying.
Usually, the track is at its fastest at the very end of the qualifying hour. But with rain forecast five minutes before the end, most teams sent their drivers out early for their final runs.

Since Zandvoort's layout puts more energy through the tyres on the left-hand side of the car, most drivers found they had to build an extra tyre-preparation lap into their runs to bring both sides up to operating temperature. Even then it was possible to arrive at the first corner on the push lap with them not quite in the right place.

Given the onset of rain in the final qualifying segment, only Ferrari stuck to this approach while the other teams directed their drivers to take the conventional approach of doing just one lap before starting to push.
"I was struggling with the balance, to be fair, throughout the whole session," said Antonelli.
"Mainly Sector 3, I was struggling in the chicane. And then just made a couple of changes and the feeling came back.

"But obviously, in the last lap I did a mistake in Sector 1. I took it a bit too easy seeing the rain on the visor and just, yeah, was a really poor Sector 1. And shame because I think we had a shot for pole."

Zandvoort's first corner is challenging in that it dips down on the approach, making it more difficult to judge the braking, but the corner itself is then cambered in the driver's favour. During qualifying on Saturday the process of judging brake effort was complicated further by uncertain tyre temperatures, the increasingly damp track surface, and a gusting headwind.

Comparing the telemetry data indicates Antonelli lifted off the throttle and braked slightly earlier for the corner than McLaren's Norris, who ultimately took pole position. Antonelli was also very early to release the brakes, suggesting he knew at this point that he had misjudged it.

Norris also lost some time in Turn 1 compared with Antonelli's teammate George Russell, who went on to qualify second. But while Norris recouped more time elsewhere on the lap to overturn Russell's advantage, Antonelli pushed too hard into Turn 3 and ran slightly wide, blunting his chances of making up time elsewhere on the lap.
He fell 0.133s short of Norris and will start third on the grid.
"In FP1 I felt very good," Antonelli said of his weekend. "Then obviously yesterday in [sprint] quali I did a mistake, and that definitely took some confidence away.

"Also, today in qualifying, mainly because the feeling was not really there with the car, I still struggled to find my rhythm and to put the lap times together. But luckily in Q3 we were able to put things a bit more together and to be on the second row."

Antonelli leads the drivers' championship on 224 points, with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton second on 171. He will be mindful of the fact that at this point last year Piastri led the standings with 309 points to Norris's 275, with Max Verstappen third on 205. Piastri didn't win another GP and went on to finish third.

detailZh: 角田裕毅：小红牛 对我迄今为止的表现“相当满意”
Tsunoda 在赞德沃特的 F1 出场中，与队友 Arvid Lindblad 的差距越来越小
角田裕毅 表示，小红牛 车队对他适应 2026 年规格 F1 赛车的方式“相当满意”，他正在代替 劳森 出战荷兰大奖赛。
哈贾尔 在夏休期间手腕受伤后，Lawson 获得了晋升至红牛的机会，因此 Tsunoda 得以在赞德沃特这个难度颇高的冲刺赛周末为 小红牛 出战。
这位26岁的车手对新一代赛车并不熟悉，但他一直在不断缩小与令人印象深刻的菜鸟队友Arvid Lindblad之间的差距。
角田裕毅在唯一一次自由练习赛中落后这位英国车手0.825秒，但他在SQ1将差距缩小到0.433秒，SQ2缩小到0.360秒，接着在Q1缩小到0.011秒，Q2缩小到0.102秒，此前他在冲刺赛中落后11.5秒。
“说实话，我非常开心，”这位日本车手欣喜地说。“当然，我非常享受这场排位赛。
“昨天的排位赛还行，但我仍然不知道极限在哪里，那时还是一辆全新的赛车。但这次排位赛更像是一场真正的排位赛，能够更加信任赛车，敢于把赛车扔进弯角。”
“我知道自己还有很大提升空间。但说实话，我怀念这种感觉很久了，追逐最后几毫秒、最后零点几秒的感觉，我现在超级享受，超级享受。”
F1的新赛车除了经过改进的底盘和空气动力学之外，还需要复杂的能量管理，角田裕毅并不回避这一事实：这在许多方面都是一项巨大的挑战。
“这是一辆不同的车，一辆完全不同的车，”他说。“刹车的感觉，你知道吗？我走进VCARB模拟器，第一感觉就是，当我像去年那样刹车时，我直接撞墙了！
“压力的大小、那些极限，都不一样。尤其是下压力也不同。还有能量释放，在哪里放电之类的，突然间赛车就会给你减速。”
“那些事情，适应起来并不容易。说实话，有很多东西我必须加紧学习，但坦白讲，我适应的速度比我预期的要快。所以，我对自己所做的事情相当满意。”
对于这位小红牛车手来说，冲刺赛让他熟悉了发车程序，同时积累了宝贵的经验。
“那24圈，每一圈我都在学习，我想我在这次排位赛中证明了这一点，每一节我都在越来越接近，”他补充道。
虽然他以0.1秒之差无缘Q3，但角田认为车队（大概）仍然对他的表现感到满意。
“车队显然希望两辆车都能进入Q3，”他承认道，他在发车格上获得了第12名。“但从昨天开始，他们对我所做的工作印象相当深刻，对我在每节练习、每一圈中取得的进步都相当满意。今天如果能进入Q3，显然会更好。
“不过我还没见到车队，所以也许他们会生气，我不知道，走着瞧吧，”角田开玩笑说。
detailEn: Yuki Tsunoda: Racing Bulls is “pretty impressed” with my performance so far
Tsunoda has been getting closer and closer to team-mate Arvid Lindblad on his Zandvoort F1 outing
Yuki Tsunoda says Racing Bulls has been “pretty impressed” with the way he has adapted to Formula 1’s 2026-spec machinery as he stands in for Liam Lawson at the Dutch Grand Prix.
Lawson got a call-up to Red Bull after Isack Hadjar injured his wrist over the summer break, hence Tsunoda’s opportunity at Racing Bulls on a tricky sprint weekend in Zandvoort.
The 26-year-old was unfamiliar with the new generation of cars but has been getting closer and closer to impressive rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad.

Tsunoda was 0.825s adrift of the Briton in the only free practice session, but brought his deficit down to 0.433s in SQ1 and 0.360s in SQ2, then 0.011s in Q1 and 0.102s in Q2, having finished the sprint race 11.5 seconds in arrears.
“Honestly, I'm super happy,” the Japanese racer rejoiced. “Certainly, I enjoyed so much this qualifying.

“Yesterday's qualifying was okay, but I didn't know where was the limit still, it was still a fresh car. But this qualifying was a bit more like a proper qualifying, able to trust more the car and throw the car into the corners.
“I know where I can improve much more. But honestly, I missed this kind of feeling, the chasing last few milliseconds, last few tenths, and I'm super enjoying it, super enjoying it.”
F1’s new machinery requires sophisticated energy management on top of the revamped chassis and aero, and Tsunoda doesn’t shy away from the fact this has been a substantial challenge in many areas.

“It's a different car, it's a completely different car,” he said. “The brake feeling, you know? I stepped into the VCARB simulator, and the first thing I felt, when I braked like last year, I was in the wall!

“The amount of pressure, those limits, it's different. And downforce especially is also different. Also deploying energy, where to discharge and everything, suddenly you get deceleration from the car.

“Those things, it was not easy to adapt. Honestly, a lot of things I have to get up to speed [with], but to be honest I was able to get used to it faster than I expected. So, I'm pretty satisfied with what I've done.”
The sprint race was useful for the Racing Bulls driver to get to grips with the start procedure while taking in invaluable experience.
“That 24 laps, every single lap I was able to learn, and I think I was able to prove that in this qualifying, every single session I was coming closer and closer,” he added.
And while Q3 eluded him by a tenth, Tsunoda reckoned the squad was (presumably) still happy with his performance.

“The team obviously wanted both cars to be in Q3,” he admitted, having taken 12th place on the grid. “But from yesterday, they were pretty impressed with what I've done and pretty happy with the steps I've done for each session, every lap. It would have been better, obviously, if I got through Q3 today.
“But I didn't meet the team yet, so maybe they're angry, I don't know, we'll see,” Tsunoda quipped.
